definitions.explanation: The act of applying fertilizer to soil or plants to promote growth.

examples.english: Fertilization is carried out in spring.

⟦{過剰|かじょう}→過剰：04123_kajou⟧な{施肥|せひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{土壌|どじょう}→土壌：12040_dojou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}させる→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
A technical term used in agriculture and gardening. Composed of ⟦{施|ほどこ}す→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧ (to apply, to give) and {肥|こえ} (fertilizer). This word is often encountered in farming manuals, gardening guides, and agricultural science.

- {施肥|せひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ — to apply fertilizer
- {施肥|せひ}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ — amount of fertilizer applied
- {施肥|せひ}⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧ — fertilizing season/timing
- ⟦{追|つい}{肥|ひ}→追肥：08232_tsuihi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to apply additional fertilizer (top-dressing)
